LanguageData.MPTurbo_EnableDesc: Off by default so installing the mod does not silently speed up your game. Turn it on explicitly.
LanguageData.MPTurbo_HostOnly: Only the host can change it
LanguageData.MPTurbo_HostOnlyDesc: Disables +/- for non-hosts. This is a client-side guard, not server enforcement.
LanguageData.MPTurbo_AutoDownshiftDesc: When a client falls behind the threshold, sync the multiplier back to 1x so it can catch up, then restore. This is a synced command affecting everyone - a local-only downshift would desync.
LanguageData.MPTurbo_ShowHudDesc: Top-right overlay: current multiplier, ticks behind, worst offenders.
LanguageData.MPTurbo_StatusNoSession: Status: Multiplayer found, not in a session
